purpose: P7 paid-provider research for historical TT data. No purchase is made by this artifact.

context.phase_c_corpus: tt_match_results via odds_api_io (api.odds-api.io/v3) — 149,672 rows, canonical event keys oaio:<id>, source_provider='odds_api_io', frozen baseline aa2ef12d...
context.phase_d_forward: OddsPapi (api.oddspapi.io/v4) — live forward fixtures + odds, sportId 25, ODDSPAPI_API_KEY in DPAPI SecretRegistry, 250 free requests/month
context.constraints: budget <= $50 preferred / $100 ceiling; trial 20-50 canonical events on 8 metrics; recommendation only if it materially improves Phase C coverage; no auto-purchase

providers_evaluated.free_tier: 100 req/hour, 500/day, 2 recreational bookmakers, all endpoints incl. /v3/historical/events and /v3/historical/odds
providers_evaluated.paid_gate: /v3/historical/closing-lines is PAID-only (403 on free); closing odds back to December 2025; bulk endpoint: 30 bookmakers/request, 100 events/response, 366-day window, league+date sweep in ~20 requests for a season
providers_evaluated.tt_coverage: Table tennis included (Phase C corpus proves it); market mapping must be re-verified (2-way moneyline) — feedback board shows historical tennis/handball market mapping bugs, so MARKET_MAPPING_INTEGRITY is a mandatory trial metric
providers_evaluated.upside: SAME provider + SAME canonical event ids as Phase C: unlocks TRUE_CLOSE (closing lines Dec 2025+) for ~40k+ TT matches, flips TRUE_CLOSE_AVAILABLE to YES, strengthens LAST_VALID_PREMATCH verification for the shadow evaluation
providers_evaluated.trial_cost: 0 (free tier covers /v3/historical/events and /v3/historical/odds for the 20-50 event sample)

providers_evaluated.free_tier: 250 requests/month, historical odds INCLUDED on free tier (no credit multiplier), 350+ bookmakers incl. Pinnacle/Singbet
providers_evaluated.paid_plans: custom quote only (per-request; B2C/B2B tiers have no published $<100 price) — cannot be budgeted under the $100 ceiling without a quote
providers_evaluated.tt_coverage: sportId 25 confirmed live (Phase D discovery uses it)
providers_evaluated.upside: historical odds at no multiplier could provide per-event line history for forward events once they settle; but no published sub-$100 tier, so deferred until volume need is proven by the soak
providers_evaluated.trial_cost: already running (Phase D soak consumes its 250 free requests)

providers_evaluated.note: historical odds cost 10x credits; NO table tennis coverage (tennis = ATP/WTA only) — does not improve Phase C coverage; rejected
no crypto books (1xBet/GG.BET absent); table tennis coverage unverified; entry price at the $100 ceiling with unproven TT depth; rejected until Odds-API.io trial shows a gap

trial_plan.scope: 20-50 canonical TT events from the Phase C corpus (oaio:<id>) with commence_at >= 2025-12-01 (closing-line availability window)
endpoints: /v3/historical/closing-lines?sport=table-tennis&leagues=<slug>&from=<iso>&to=<iso> (expect 403 on free tier — that 403 IS the paid-gate probe)
trial_plan.cost: $0 (free tier, within the 100 req/hour / 500 per day budget)

eight_metrics.definition: fraction of sampled canonical oaio: ids recoverable from /v3/historical/events
fraction of events whose /v3/historical/odds returns non-empty bookmakers
distinct bookmakers per event (free tier caps at 2; paid 30)
closing-lines rows returned vs 403 paid-gate probe
presence + precision of createdAt/updatedAt on odds entries
historical scores/status agree with tt_match_results for sampled events
2-way moneyline mapping clean for TT (no cross-market leakage like the reported tennis set-spread bug)

trial_plan.decision_rule: purchase Odds-API.io Solo if and only if: EVENT_MATCH_RATE >= 90%, ODDS_AVAILABILITY >= 80%, CLOSING_LINE_AVAILABILITY confirms Dec-2025+ closing rows, and MARKET_MAPPING_INTEGRITY is clean on all sampled events

recommendation.expected_cost: GBP 49/mo (approx USD 63-66) — above the $50 preferred band, within the $100 ceiling; one-month purchase is the smallest unit
why_worth_buying: Same provider and same canonical event ids as Phase C — no new identity establishment risk (Phase D's MATCH_RATE gate stays intact)
Unlocks /v3/historical/closing-lines: closing odds for every settled TT event from December 2025 (a season-length bulk sweep in ~20 requests)
Makes TRUE_CLOSE available for prematch evaluation — currently TRUE_CLOSE_AVAILABLE=NO and shadow evaluation only uses OPEN/INTERMEDIATE/LAST_VALID_PREMATCH
Closing lines let Phase D verify LAST_VALID_PREMATCH fidelity and give the Phase E wager gate its required market-reference integrity check
Free tier already covers the whole trial, so the purchase decision is evidence-based, not speculative
recommendation.deferred: OddsPapi paid tier — no published sub-$100 plan; revisit only after the soak proves >250 requests/month are needed for forward collection
recommendation.purchase_gate: NOT_PURCHASED — this artifact authorizes the $0 free-tier trial; any purchase requires owner sign-off and a separate purchase record

risks: Odds-API.io historically reported market-mapping bugs for tennis/handball (set spreads vs game spreads, 3-way vs 2-way) — TT 2-way moneyline must be re-verified in the trial before trusting closing lines
Closing lines only cover events from December 2025 onward; pre-Dec-2025 Phase C corpus remains without TRUE_CLOSE
GBP pricing exposes the Solo plan to FX drift (49 GBP currently ~USD 63-66); budget must tolerate up to the $100 ceiling
Free-tier rate limits (100 req/hour) make bulk backfills slow; the trial sample of 20-50 events stays well within limits

artifacts.stop_gate_parent: Phase D stop gate follows this artifact
